comparisons: DS and SD against both SS and DD within each learner; condition means weight the three learners equally. Also report the 144 layouts outside the monitor panel.
inference_limit: Comparison of complete action-selection strategies. Purchases can change subsequent deployment states; this is not a controlled same-army deployment experiment. Three trained learners per condition; do not treat attacks as independent learners.
phase_rule: Use vector[6]: 0 shopping, 1 battle. Validate against the Finish shopping action mask. Finish shopping uses the purchasing rule; all battle decisions use the deployment rule.
primary_metric: fraction of building VALUE destroyed, reported as a percentage
rng_rule: Reset Python, NumPy and Torch once per episode using version2.evaluation.episode_seed(label, base, view). Do not reseed at the phase boundary. Deterministic decisions consume no sampling draws, so deployment draws are not synchronized across modes with different purchasing rules.
scope: Exploratory development diagnostic specified after the full-development evaluation and replay review; not preregistered before training and not a final test.
selection_limit: Any stronger mode discovered here is development-selected and needs a fixed subsequent final-test protocol. No guaranteed improvement is assumed.
training: None. No checkpoint, reward, movement or targeting changes.
